bio: Please note that Vale Royal Abbey will be closed from 5th August - 5th September 2024 for a refurbishment.  Vale Royal Abbey a privately owned, impressive and imposing building set with 150 acres of lush, mature ground, close to the River Weaver, Chester and Delamere Forest.  Afternoon Tea is mostly served in their Lounge Bar, a beautiful and intimate setting overlooking the venue's 18-hole championship golf course.  You may also enjoy Afternoon Tea in the elegant surroundings of The Library or the Great Hall.  Their Afternoon Tea menu comprises of a mouth-watering selection of fresh, traditional finger sandwiches, a tempting array of homemade cakes and desserts and freshly baked scones with clotted cream and jam.  This is accompanied by a choice of teas from around the world or you may choose to have coffee as an alternative.  Please note that Vale Royal Abbey require payment to be made in full in order to secure your booking. A member of their team will contact you when they receive your enquiry to arrange this.
